tools.name: check_domain_availability
tools.description: Check whether a domain name is available to register (WHOIS/RDAP lookup). Read-only: it does not register anything.

domain.description: Fully qualified domain name, e.g. example.com

tools.name: get_forward_email_overview
tools.description: Get a concise, up-to-date overview of Forward Email (features, plans, protocols, security, comparisons and links to docs) as plain text (llms.txt).

tools.name: get_forward_email_pricing
tools.description: Get Forward Email monthly plan prices in USD (free, enhanced, team, enterprise) and a link to the full plan comparison.

tools.name: get_mail_server_ip_addresses
tools.description: List Forward Email's outbound mail server hostnames with their IPv4 and IPv6 addresses (for allowlists and firewall rules).

tools.name: search_domain_names
tools.description: Check whether a domain name is available to register, or generate available domain name ideas from a keyword. Results are shown in the domain search dialog.

tools.name: search_forward_email_docs
tools.description: Search Forward Email's help center, FAQ, guides and developer docs (DNS setup, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, IMAP/SMTP settings, API, pricing). Opens the results page.

tools.name: search_forward_email_help
tools.description: Search Forward Email's FAQ, guides and developer docs. Returns up to 10 results with title, URL and a short excerpt.

query.description: Keywords, letters and numbers only, at most 50 characters (e.g. "DKIM", "IMAP settings").
